M1 — 2026-10-10
The bench Claude profile (~/.bench/claude-config) hit its seven-day usage limit on 2026-10-10 and resets 2026-10-11T17:00Z. In `sofar drive`, a launch refused for a usage limit shows only as "no session registered by claude-code since the launch (exit 1)", and two in a row stall the run, because the claude-code adapter drops the stream's rate_limit_event. `node test-e2e/drive-lanes/run.mjs --label probe --probe` launches one session the way the adapter does and keeps its stream, which names the limit and when it resets.
